integrity: Proof given for all stated parameters; accompanying arithmetic checks are supplementary. No independent mathematical audit, certification, or third-party validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only torus-fixed points of the normal projective toric variety of the complete-graph spanning-tree polytope are classified. All n>=4 are proved symbolically; finite checks cover n=4,5,6 and do not prove the general statement. Local analytic equations and non-fixed-point class groups are not determined. Established general matroid facet and toric divisor theorems supply major inputs, so historical-priority risk remains.
title: Subtree-indexed local divisor classes of complete-graph spanning-tree toric varieties
